newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: The French 10-year bond future settled easier in what analysts said was a correction after the market's strong run.
"People are still positive but there was such a run-up in the last while, it's a healthy to have a correction," said one economist.
The 10-year bond future finished 0.36 basis points lower at 132.26, little changed from its morning levels.
Over the short term, in the absence of major market-moving news, the market will be guided by technical factors, one analyst said.
